title: Task scope & human ownership
levels: I can distinguish organizing information from deciding an award.
I can define a bounded task using a fictional packet.
Our workflow names the human decision owner and escalation route.
We review errors, overrides, and applicant feedback on a schedule.
evidence: A workflow with a named owner and one stop condition.

title: Structured prompting
levels: I can identify task, criteria, evidence, limits, and output.
I can draft and test a constrained prompt with synthetic data.
Our team uses a versioned prompt and checks its output against sources.
We retest changes and share examples of failures and revisions.
evidence: A prompt plus a corrected evidence table.

title: Rubrics & reviewer calibration
levels: I can explain an observable criterion and its scoring anchors.
I can score the same fictional case independently and compare reasons.
Our reviewers calibrate before use and record disagreements and overrides.
We examine consistency and inequitable patterns, then revise and retest.
evidence: An anchored rubric and a disagreement log.

title: Data protection & approved tools
levels: I can identify sensitive data and why a public chatbot is not a default destination.
I can rehearse minimization and a data approval gate with synthetic data.
We verify service terms, access, retention, deletion, and incident ownership.
We audit approved uses and revisit settings, contracts, and access over time.
evidence: A documented data gate and service approval decision.

title: Applicant AI use & fair response
levels: I can distinguish a detector signal from proof of a rule violation.
I can explain permitted uses, disclosure, and a fair follow-up.
Our published rules include accessible explanations and review or appeal.
We review policy outcomes and revise confusing or unfair requirements.
evidence: A policy starter and one worked response scenario.

title: Pilot evaluation & transparency
levels: I can name an error that could harm an applicant.
I can test a small fictional set against a human reference.
Our pilot logs source errors, omissions, review time, and stop conditions.
We publish appropriate process information and monitor after changes.
evidence: A pilot plan with baseline, measures, owner, and stop rule.
